description: The business half as a decision table a business analyst can read: which role may do which operation. The built-in guards and the HR approval policy still apply beside it, and a Deny anywhere wins.
dmn:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="sp-roles" name="SharePoint roles" namespace="http://atlas/authz">
  <inputData id="in_op" name="operation"/>
  <inputData id="in_roles" name="subjectRoles"/>
  <decision id="sharepointAccess" name="sharepointAccess">
    <informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#in_op"/></informationRequirement>
    <informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#in_roles"/></informationRequirement>
    <decisionTable id="dt" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="i1" label="Manager"><inputExpression id="ie1" typeRef="boolean"><text>list contains(subjectRoles, "manager")</text></inputExpression></input>
      <input id="i2" label="Operation"><inputExpression id="ie2" typeRef="string"><text>operation</text></inputExpression></input>
      <output id="o1" name="effect" typeRef="string"/>
      <output id="o2" name="reasonCode" typeRef="string"/>
      <rule id="r1"><inputEntry id="r1a"><text>true</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="r1b"><text>"delete-file","delete-item"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="r1c"><text>"Permit"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="r1d"><text>"MANAGER_DELETE"</text></outputEntry></rule>
      <rule id="r2"><inputEntry id="r2a"><text>-</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="r2b"><text>"delete-file","delete-item"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="r2c"><text>"Deny"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="r2d"><text>"DELETE_NOT_ALLOWED"</text></outputEntry></rule>
      <rule id="r3"><inputEntry id="r3a"><text>-</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="r3b"><text>"get-file","download-file","list-folder","get-item","list-items"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="r3c"><text>"Permit"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="r3d"><text>"READ"</text></outputEntry></rule>
      <rule id="r4"><inputEntry id="r4a"><text>-</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="r4b"><text>"create-item","update-item"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="r4c"><text>"Permit"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="r4d"><text>"LIST_WRITE"</text></outputEntry></rule>
      <rule id="r5"><inputEntry id="r5a"><text>-</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="r5b"><text>-</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="r5c"><text>"NotApplicable"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="r5d"><text>""</text></outputEntry></rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>
